title: ImageConfig
description: The notifier image's config file (advisorydeck.yml), mounted read-only. Webhook URLs are secrets: the file names the environment variables that hold them and never contains them.

url.description: Base URL of the published feed, ending in /api/v1/.

poll_interval.description: How often to check the manifest, for example 30m. Minimum 5m. Default 30m.

products.description: What you run. version is a branch (17) or an exact version (17.4). Each slug at most once.

min_severity.description: Lowest severity to notify. Default high. Bypass rules (KEV, required curated action) ignore it.

mode.description: instant: post each match when seen. digest: one daily message, bypass rules still post instantly. both: post each match and include it in the digest. Default digest.

time.description: Local time of the daily digest, HH:MM. Default 08:00.

timezone.description: IANA time zone name. Default UTC.

url_env.description: Name of the environment variable that holds the webhook URL.

state_path.description: Where the image keeps what it already sent. Default /data/state.json.
